title: Law professor Ralph Sarmiento declines to testify in Sara Duterte impeachment trial

blocks.text: A former law school dean refuses to testify as the first defense witness in the impeachment trial of Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte. The defense has asked the Senate impeachment court to subpoena 24 other witnesses as it prepares to begin its presentation on Monday.
